intro_en: Follow an archaeological team as they open an elite Xiongnu tomb, and learn vocabulary for burials, grave goods, and nobility. You will also learn to draw careful conclusions from evidence with -сан шинжтэй, the Mongolian counterpart of English "there are signs that" and "there is evidence that."
intro_mn: Хүннүгийн язгууртны булшийг малтаж буй археологийн багийг дагаж, оршуулга, дагалдах эд өлгийн зүйл, язгууртантай холбоотой үгсийг сурна. Мөн баримтад тулгуурласан дүгнэлтийг "-сан шинжтэй" хэлбэрээр болон англи хэлний "there are signs that", "there is evidence that" бүтцээр илэрхийлж сурна.

vocab.example_mn: Энэ булш хоёр мянга гаруй жилийн настай.
vocab.example_en: This tomb is more than two thousand years old.

vocab.example_mn: Хүннүгийн оршуулгын ёс маш нарийн байжээ.
vocab.example_en: Xiongnu burial customs were very elaborate.

vocab.example_mn: Дагалдах эд өлгийн зүйлс талийгаачийн нийгмийн байр суурийг харуулдаг.
vocab.example_en: Grave goods reveal the social status of the deceased.

vocab.example_mn: Энэ булшинд Хүннүгийн нэгэн язгууртан оршуулагдсан байна.
vocab.example_en: A Xiongnu noble is buried in this tomb.

vocab.example_mn: Олон булшийг эрт дээр үед тоножээ.
vocab.example_en: Many tombs were looted long ago.

vocab.example_mn: Модон авс бараг бүрэн хадгалагдсан байв.
vocab.example_en: The wooden coffin was almost completely preserved.
The excavation will last three months.

vocab.example_mn: Мөргөцөг нь булшны хонгил руу шууд хүргэдэг.
vocab.example_en: The ramp leads straight to the burial chamber.
The remains were removed very carefully.

vocab.example_mn: Хүрэл тогоо булшны хойд хэсгээс олдсон.
vocab.example_en: A bronze cauldron was found in the northern part of the tomb.

sentences.mn: Энэ булшийг эртний тонуулчид тоносон шинжтэй.
sentences.en: There are signs that ancient looters robbed this tomb.
alt_mn: Энэ булшийг эрт дээр үед тоносон шинжтэй.
alt_en: There is evidence that this tomb was robbed by ancient looters.
This tomb appears to have been robbed by ancient looters.
sentences.mn_latin: Ene bulshiig ertnii tonuulchid tonoson shinjtei.

sentences.en: There is evidence that the coffin was decorated with gold ornaments.
alt_en: There are signs that the coffin was decorated with gold ornaments.
The coffin appears to have been decorated with gold ornaments.

sentences.mn: Энд оршуулсан хүн язгууртан байсан шинжтэй.
sentences.en: There are signs that the person buried here was a noble.
alt_mn: Энд оршуулагдсан хүн язгууртан байсан шинжтэй.
alt_en: There is evidence that the person buried here was a noble.
The person buried here appears to have been a noble.
sentences.mn_latin: End orshuulsan khün yazguurtan baisan shinjtei.

sentences.mn: Дагалдах эд өлгийн зүйлсийн дунд Хятадын хүрэл толь, Ромын шилэн аяга олдсон.
sentences.en: Among the grave goods were a Chinese bronze mirror and a Roman glass bowl.
alt_en: A Chinese bronze mirror and a Roman glass bowl were found among the grave goods.
sentences.mn_latin: Dagaldakh ed ölgiin züilsiin dund Khyatadyn khürel toli, Romyn shilen ayaga oldson.

sentences.en: There are signs that the soil in the ramp was disturbed again.
alt_en: There is evidence that the ramp fill was disturbed a second time.

sentences.mn: Шарилыг толгойг нь хойд зүгт харуулан оршуулсан шинжтэй.
sentences.en: There is evidence that the body was buried with its head pointing north.
alt_en: There are signs that the body was buried with its head facing north.
sentences.mn_latin: Sharilyg tolgoig ni khoid zügt kharuulan orshuulsan shinjtei.

sentences.en: There are signs that the bronze cauldron was broken on purpose.
alt_en: There is evidence that the bronze cauldron was deliberately broken.
The bronze cauldron appears to have been broken deliberately.

sentences.mn: Малтлагын баг булшны хонгилд хүрэхийн тулд гурван долоо хоног ажилласан.
sentences.en: The excavation team worked for three weeks to reach the burial chamber.
alt_mn: Малтлагын баг булшны хонгилд хүрэхэд гурван долоо хоног зарцуулсан.
alt_en: It took the excavation team three weeks to reach the burial chamber.
sentences.mn_latin: Maltlagyn bag bulshny khongild khürekhiin tuld gurvan doloo khonog ajillasan.

sentences.mn: Морьдыг эзэнтэй нь хамт оршуулсан шинжтэй.
sentences.en: There are signs that horses were buried together with their owner.
alt_en: There is evidence that horses were buried along with their owner.
sentences.mn_latin: Moridyg ezentei ni khamt orshuulsan shinjtei.

sentences.mn: Энэ булш тонуулд өртсөн ч олон эд зүйл үлдсэн байна.
sentences.en: Although this tomb was looted, many objects remain.
alt_mn: Энэ булшийг тоносон ч олон эд зүйл үлджээ.
alt_en: Even though the tomb was looted, many objects are still there.
sentences.mn_latin: Ene bulsh tonuuld örtsön ch olon ed züil üldsen baina.

sentences.mn: Торгон хувцасны үлдэгдэл олдсон нь худалдааны харилцаа өргөн байсныг харуулж байна.
sentences.en: The remains of silk clothing show that trade connections were extensive.
alt_en: The discovery of silk clothing remnants shows that trade ties were widespread.
sentences.mn_latin: Torgon khuvtsasny üldegdel oldson ni khudaldaany khariltsaa örgön baisnyg kharuulj baina.

sentences.mn: Булшийг нэгээс олон удаа хөндсөн шинжтэй гэж археологич тэмдэглэв.
sentences.en: The archaeologist noted that there were signs that the tomb had been disturbed more than once.
alt_en: The archaeologist noted evidence that the tomb had been disturbed more than once.
sentences.mn_latin: Bulshiig negees olon udaa khöndsön shinjtei gej arkhyeologich temdeglev.

grammar.title_mn: Баримтад тулгуурласан дүгнэлт: there is evidence that / there are signs that
grammar.explain_en: To state a conclusion based on physical evidence, Mongolian puts a past participle (-сан/-сон/-сэн/-сөн, chosen by vowel harmony) before шинжтэй, literally "having the signs of." For example, тоносон шинжтэй means "there are signs that it was looted." The speaker didn't witness the event but sees clear traces of it, which makes this the standard hedged phrasing in scientific reports. Compare -сан бололтой ("apparently, it seems"), which is more of a general guess, and -сан нь тодорхой ("it is clear that"), which shows full certainty. The subject or object stays in its normal case: Булшийг тоносон шинжтэй.
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд баримтад тулгуурласан дүгнэлтийг ихэвчлэн "There is evidence that + өгүүлбэр" эсвэл "There are signs that + өгүүлбэр" гэж илэрхийлдэг: There are signs that the tomb was looted. "Evidence" нь тоологдохгүй нэр учраас "evidences" гэж хэлэхгүй, "There is" гэсэн ганц тоогоор хэрэглэнэ. Харин "signs" нь олон тоотой тул "There are" болно. Нэр үг эсвэл -ing хэлбэрийн өмнө "of" орно: The chamber shows signs of having been reopened. Мөн "appears to have been + V3" бүтэц байдаг: The tomb appears to have been looted. Энэ нь "-сан шинжтэй"-тэй ойролцоо утгатай.

examples.mn: Булшийг эрт дээр үед тоносон шинжтэй.
examples.en: There are signs that the tomb was looted long ago.
examples.mn_latin: Bulshiig ert deer üyed tonoson shinjtei.

examples.en: There is evidence that the coffin was covered in silk.

examples.en: The chamber shows signs of having been opened a second time.
examples.mn_latin: Khongilyg khoyor dakhi udaagaa neesen shinjtei.

examples.en: The deceased appears to have been a high-ranking noble.
examples.mn_latin: Taliigaach öndör zeregtei yazguurtan baisan shinjtei.

fill_blank.translation: There are signs that looters robbed the tomb.
fill_blank.explain_en: шинжтэй needs a past participle in front of it. Тоносон is the -сон participle of тонох, chosen by vowel harmony with о. Тонох points to the future, and тонож and тоносоор are converbs, so neither can modify шинжтэй.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "шинжтэй"-н өмнө өнгөрсөн цагийн үйлт нэр орно. "тонох" үйл үгийн о эгшигтэй зохицож "-сон" залгавар авна: тоносон. "тонох" нь ирээдүйг заадаг, "тонож", "тоносоор" нь нөхцөл үйл тул "шинжтэй"-тэй хэрэглэгдэхгүй.

fill_blank.translation: There is evidence that the coffin was decorated with gold ornaments.
fill_blank.explain_en: The construction -сан + шинжтэй states a conclusion drawn from visible traces. Тухай ("about"), байдлаар ("in the manner of"), and хамт ("together with") can't end the sentence after a participle here.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Баримтад тулгуурласан дүгнэлтийг "-сан шинжтэй" гэж илэрхийлнэ. "тухай", "байдлаар", "хамт" нь энд өгүүлбэрийг төгсгөж чадахгүй.

fill_blank.text: Шарилыг толгойг нь хойд зүгт харуулан оршуул___ шинжтэй.
fill_blank.translation: There is evidence that the body was buried with its head pointing north.
fill_blank.explain_en: Оршуулах ends in the back vowels у/а, so the past participle takes -сан: оршуулсан. The other options break vowel harmony.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "оршуулах" үйл үгийн сүүлийн эгшиг у/а тул эгшиг зохицох ёсоор "-сан" залгана: оршуулсан.

fill_blank.text: There is ___ that the tomb was looted in antiquity.
fill_blank.translation: Булшийг эрт дээр үед тоносон шинжтэй.
fill_blank.explain_en: Evidence is uncountable, so it takes "there is" with no plural -s. "Proof of" can't be followed by a that-clause, and "signs" is plural, so it would need "there are," not "there is."
fill_blank.explain_mn: "evidence" тоологдохгүй нэр тул олон тоо авахгүй бөгөөд "There is"-тэй хэрэглэнэ. "proof of"-ийн дараа "that" өгүүлбэр орохгүй. "signs" олон тоотой тул "There are" шаардана.

fill_blank.text: There are signs ___ the horses were buried with their owner.
fill_blank.translation: Морьдыг эзэнтэй нь хамт оршуулсан шинжтэй.
fill_blank.explain_en: "Signs" followed by a full clause takes "that." Use "of" only before a noun or an -ing form.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "signs"-ийн дараа бүтэн өгүүлбэр (субьект + үйл үг) ирвэл "that" хэрэглэнэ. "of" зөвхөн нэр үг эсвэл -ing хэлбэрийн өмнө орно.

fill_blank.text: The burial chamber shows signs ___ having been reopened.
fill_blank.explain_en: "Show signs of" is followed by a noun or an -ing form, here "having been reopened." "That" would need a full clause after it.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "show signs of" гэсэн тогтвортой хэллэгийн дараа нэр үг эсвэл -ing хэлбэр орно. "that"-ийн дараа бүтэн өгүүлбэр шаардлагатай.

dialogue.speaker: Батболд
dialogue.mn: Эмили, мөргөцгийн хөрсийг хар даа. Өнгө нь өөр байна.
dialogue.en: Emily, look at the soil in the ramp. The color is different.
dialogue.mn_latin: Emili, mörgötsgiin khörsiig khar daa. Öngö ni öör baina.

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.mn: Тийм ээ. Энэ хэсгийг хожим дахин ухсан шинжтэй.
dialogue.en: Yes. There are signs that this section was dug up again later.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim ee. Ene khesgiig khojim dakhin ukhsan shinjtei.

dialogue.speaker: Сарнай
dialogue.mn: Тэгвэл булшийг тоносон байх магадлалтай юу?
dialogue.en: So is it likely that the tomb was looted?
dialogue.mn_latin: Tegvel bulshiig tonoson baikh magadlaltai yuu?

dialogue.speaker: Батболд
dialogue.mn: Тийм бололтой. Гэхдээ авс бүрэн эвдрээгүй, дагалдах эд өлгийн зүйлсийн зарим нь үлдсэн байна.
dialogue.en: It seems so. But the coffin isn't completely destroyed, and some of the grave goods are still there.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim bololtoi. Gekhdee avs büren evdreegüi, dagaldakh ed ölgiin züilsiin zarim ni üldsen baina.

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.mn: Энэ хүрэл тогоог зориуд хагалсан шинжтэй. Оршуулгын зан үйлтэй холбоотой байж магадгүй.
dialogue.en: There is evidence that this bronze cauldron was broken on purpose. It might be connected to a burial ritual.
dialogue.mn_latin: Ene khürel togoog zoriud khagalsan shinjtei. Orshuulgyn zan üiltei kholbootoi baij magadgüi.

dialogue.speaker: Сарнай
dialogue.mn: Алтан чимэглэл, торгоны үлдэгдэл хоёроос харахад талийгаач язгууртан байсан шинжтэй.
dialogue.en: Judging by the gold ornaments and the silk remnants, there are signs that the deceased was a noble.
dialogue.mn_latin: Altan chimeglel, torgony üldegdel khoyoroos kharakhad taliigaach yazguurtan baisan shinjtei.

dialogue.speaker: Батболд
dialogue.mn: Сайн ажиглалт байна. Шарилыг гаргахаас өмнө бүх зүйлийг зураг авч тэмдэглэе.
dialogue.en: Good observation. Let's photograph and record everything before we remove the remains.
dialogue.mn_latin: Sain ajiglalt baina. Sharilyg gargakhaas ömnö bükh züiliig zurag avch temdegleye.

culture_note.en: The Xiongnu (Хүннү) ruled the steppe from the 3rd century BCE to the 1st century CE, and Mongolia traces the origins of its statehood to the Xiongnu state founded in 209 BCE. Elite Xiongnu tombs, such as those at Noyon Uul and Gol Mod, are large square structures with a long entrance ramp (мөргөцөг). Despite ancient looting, they have yielded Chinese silk and lacquerware, gold ornaments, and even Roman glass, which reveals a vast network of trade.
culture_note.mn: Хүннү нар МЭӨ III зуунаас МЭ I зууныг хүртэл тал нутгийг захирч байсан бөгөөд Монгол Улс төрт ёсныхоо эхийг МЭӨ 209 онд байгуулагдсан Хүннү гүрэнтэй холбодог. Ноён уул, Гол мод зэрэг газрын Хүннүгийн язгууртны булш нь урт мөргөцөгтэй, том дөрвөлжин хийцтэй. Эрт дээр үед тоногдсон ч эдгээр булшнаас Хятадын торго, лакан эдлэл, алтан чимэглэл, бүр Ромын шилэн эдлэл олдсон нь худалдааны өргөн сүлжээ байсныг харуулдаг.

review.notes: A strong, accurate lesson. The main problems were a wrong term for lacquerware, a missing genitive, and two fill-in-the-blank items with more than one correct answer.

opus_fix.notes: Fixed case errors, unnatural phrasing and a weak alt_mn, and made the en/mn explanations match.

"толгойгоор нь хойш" is awkward and ambiguous (хойш can mean "backward")
хамт requires the comitative: эзэнтэй нь хамт
same case error as the sentence
mn version left out what en says about тонох
